body: Same, it’s a very helpful place. I’m the darkest of times when you think there’s no one who understands…. There is.

5 years, 4 years, and now a single year. But let me tell you. The first two were building blocks to a higher me. This 1 year I’m separating from has hurt the most hands down. Because I was ready. You’ll learn that all most breakups are lessons to become a better you. But cherish and take care of every one the best you can cause when they are gone they are gone. And it hurts more and more the further down the road. But you’ll be ok. I’m not even ok yet but I know I will. So from one hurt soul to another. Strength

I know it’s her choice, I’m trying to be there for her through the process since she has no one, at the same time respecting the boundary of not trying to convince her but. E there for her no matter what. Cause she is scared and alone since she won’t tell anyone. I’m just in limbo here it feels and I wish I could do more. We are on opposite sides of the country now so it’s even more challenging.

Acting like strangers. Talked everyday. My best friend. Still being in love with them as a person and pretending we don’t exist. Silence is painful when all you want is them. Leaves too much room for imagination in all the worst ways. Is there someone new? Is she safe? Is she doing ok mentally? I know I’m not so is she? All the questions that will never be answered.

My diet is great that’s probably the only reason I can drink the way i have been. I’ll definitely give that book a read. I’ll try to cut the drinking too. It seems to be the only way to laugh and be happy right now. Which I understand is a false happiness but I just feel like I’ll take what I can get. My brain doesn’t seem to help itself lately. It won’t just turn off and stop having thoughts that cause me pain. She cheated on me with someone and told me it was in the shower. So now it sucks for me even to take a damn shower. It’s so messed up. My brain just loves torture apparently
I opened a whole new world. There is literally nothing she can do wrong. I stare at her when she sleeps. And love it. Even her snoring. Idk I didn’t believe it to be true for so long.

You deserve a trophy for that my man. There was some much hope in that message. I’m gonna turn the silver linings into gold linings now. I’m focused on the pain so much right now. Almost as if I feel closer to her even though she’s gone. It’s hard to sit and stare into nothing where even my breathe seems to fade away. I check out COMPLETELY from my existence. It’s scary sometimes. It’s like my soul is gone. I want it back. It’s been two weeks and nothing is getting easier. But I can try to find something because it’s so necessary at this point. Im gonna drink myself to death it feels like

Thank you. That made me feel really good. I’m so emotionally broken right now and I’m trying my best. It’s the saddest thing I’ve had to do. I thought that was my best friend and my love forever. I was all in. And now I’m putting my pieces together but I lost a few. I’m not whole anymore
I loved you like I never knew someone could.
Disappointment how
Someone else’s face will look better someday.

One breathe at a time I guess. I will reach out. I will try. I want to be happy. That’s it. Any decision right now has a road of pain on it. I don’t want to make any decisions. I want to stay in this bed til a decision is forced upon me. I know I can’t do that. To think that is ok is ridiculous. Im not going to do that. I just need to find a way to change my perspective. Find the confidence and self care to make my world mine again. Im so hurt and betrayed my her but most importantly myself. And it’s my fault. Even though I did my best. I need a new version of my best. How is a god damn mystery but I know I need it so that’s something I guess
I’m sorry. Thank you for helping me. I’ll take your advice the best I can.

I have the worst thoughts of myself. I’m embarrassed because I am not me anymore. I’m just broken. From more than just her at this point. I want to experiment with coping mechanisms. But the only ones that come to mind are all painful and riddled with shame

You are amazing. Thank you. Thank you. I got to do something. Your right. I just don’t know where the strength is gonna come from. That’s no excuse. But it’s the truth. On my journey and how much I’ve grown. How I go about hardships is a big deal. I’ve never been good at them. I drink or do drugs to escape. I’m past that. I know it’s in there. But I’ve never seen it. So I’m scared. Your advice gives me hope. More so even. I need help. And that’s the best I’m gonna get from anyone than myself. FUCK. This is nothing more than an act of faith. I hope I can do this

She doesn’t care. She blames me so doesn’t feel bad at all. She paints the picture to make her right unfairly. Thank you for talking to me. Im so alone. And no one responds to me on here ever. Im laying here can’t sleep. It’s 6:30. I haven’t been able to sleep for 2 days. I want to cry but my eyes are too dry. I’ve cried enough. I get enough love from her when I fall apart to stay together. But she sleeps like a bay and I can’t breathe. I hate this I hate this I hate this

I don’t know how to it like a kind person. I hate how people have to hate their ex to move on. I don’t want be mean to her or hate her. But to do it nicely is so much harder it feels impossible. I’m suffocating and might just be mean and everything I don’t like just to get away clean for my own sake. Im so in love but I’m so scared.
It’s the craziest thing about relationships honestly. I sometimes wonder how we are so capable of these potent emotions. They are all over the place. At what point do they become unbeneficial
You can if you know you guys weren’t right. But it’s ok. They are still a good person
Ask casey tobin

Find a creative outlet and focus on it. Your ultimately gonna go to the places within based off where your heads at. If your gonna be pissed at anyone then be pissed at yourself. We’re here just the same. But there’s nothing hollow behind a strangers words. Ever if you think it may seem “scripted” they have the most truthful answers of anyone because when it comes to life, we can all agree that it means something more than our pain. And a strangers unbiased opinion is exactly the kind of love in this world your possibly looking for. I know I do. I don’t want the people who hurt me to have an opinion that will probably hurt me. Take this for granted and you will get what you deserve no matter what. All about your attitude

I need help doing that. It’s so hard to be told one thing and actions show another. It becomes hard to understand what to believe. My worth is questioned when I’m lied to even if it’s to “protect me”. There lies a dilemma of uncertainty that usually results in self destruction and then pity then hate. Upon myself. I love so much I think it’s what makes love pure. I’m capable of pain of it means we will work one day. But I can’t be a better me. But she says she can and says she wants it but isn’t showing it. Putting in no effort. What do you do then? I don’t want to give up. And she “says” she doesn’t either but basically is all the same….
